text: Morning, Mira! Three regulars are due. Take their orders, bring each one what I make, and close the till before ten.
That's the spirit. Here comes Aoi!
After the rush! Here comes Aoi.
Morning! Something warm and milky, please. Not too strong.
Perfect. Thank you!
Oh. Well, if you say so.
Hi! Something cold, please? It's already warm out.
Lovely, thanks.
Hot? Hm. All right, then.
Just a green tea for me, please.
Thank you!
That's not what I said. But fine.
Order up for table one!
Order up for table two!
Order up for table three!
That's everyone! Close the till, Mira.
Not one mistake. Best morning rush ever, Mira!
We made it! Even with a mix-up.
See you tomorrow.
Ten o'clock, and the till is still open. We'll do better tomorrow.
Two orders wrong. Let's call it a morning, and try again tomorrow.
